svg.title: European outreach detail
svg.desc: Cyan: France, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Portugal, Czechia, Slovakia, Belgium, Croatia, Romania, Latvia, Hungary, Iceland, Bulgaria, Greece, Cyprus, Slovenia, Mauritius, Georgia, Austria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda and Sri Lanka, contacted on 26 October 2026 through 25 emails and one acknowledged form submission. Kazakhstan outreach was to AFSA within the AIFC. Austria used the FMA general mailbox; dedicated form acceptance is unconfirmed. Green: country and territory entries in the historical outreach list, still under review. Colors do not indicate regulatory receipt, approval or endorsement. EU-level outreach is listed separately on the page.
